evidence.mac: Mac17,8 (Apple silicon): install items in a clean tart VM on it (s7-121, cloned from tahoe-base, deleted after), 11 Nov
evidence.notes: Run on these exact bytes (the draft's DMG, sha256 1fcd4668..., downloaded from the draft (release 442182749) with gh into a fresh folder and hash-checked, the draft's digests of the DMG and the zip read back and matching, and the release state's; copied into a fresh clone of tahoe-base and given Safari's quarantine flag), 11 Nov, clean macOS 26.6.2 (no Marver, no ~/.marver before; Gatekeeper: assessments enabled, developer id enabled): the DMG opened and mounted (Marver 1.2.1); Marver double-clicked in its window - the disk-image question ('This item is on the disk image "Marver-arm64.dmg". Safari downloaded this disk image today... Apple checked it for malicious software and none was detected'), Open; the silent move (/Applications/Marver.app there before the second answer; app.jsonl: update move moved 1.2.1; update.json's move already cleared as read); macOS's second question ('This file was downloaded on an unknown date. Apple checked it...'), Open; Home's empty state: 'No canvas running yet' with its three cards, screenshot vm/shots/s7-121-4-home.png; running from /Applications/Marver.app (not translocated: no AppTranslocation process); spctl: accepted, Notarized Developer ID, Developer ID Application: Nicolas Touron (PXV6WER853); codesign design.marver.app, team PXV6WER853; version 1.2.1 (CFBundleShortVersionString and CFBundleVersion; app.jsonl start: release flavour, electron 45.0.0); launch none-restored; the update check answered current. The 1.1 items again on these bytes: app-live.json written (scheme 1, version 1.2.1), LaunchServices resolves marver: to /Applications/Marver.app, and a marver://open?ws=<a folder> link opened in the VM reached the app (app.jsonl: cmd deep-link done) and, with no canvas running, showed Home's board with that folder's card under Not running, its menu open with Copy start command first (vm/shots/s7-121-5-link.png); a bare marver://show was refused as bad, as designed. New in 1.2.1, on these bytes: D on Home (focus off the link field, no menu open) switched light to dark (vm/shots/s7-121-6-d-before.png, s7-121-7-d-after.png; ~/.marver/theme.json written mode dark; app.jsonl cmd setting via key in home, done) and D again back to light (s7-121-8-d-back.png, theme.json mode light); Marver > Settings... opened the Settings tab (its gear on the tab; app.jsonl cmd settings via menu, done): the new glass page, 'Settings - Saved as plain files in ~/.marver/', its Updates group first with the app icon, 'Marver 1.2.1', 'Marver is up to date', Check for updates, 'Last checked a minute ago' and 'Download updates automatically' (autoUpdate, on), then Appearance (Theme System/Light/Dark, 'switch with D'), Tabs (vm/shots/s7-121-10-settings.png). NOT re-run by hand on 1.2.1: notice-ask, notice-banner, dock-badge, notice-denied, settings-link, signin, shared-card, live-picture - carried over from Nic's hand checks of 0.3.0 on 31 Oct (#53), as for 1.0.0, 1.0.1, 1.1.0 and 1.2.0 by Nic's decision; 1.2.1 does not touch the notices or sign-in (it changes Settings, the theme key on Home and Settings, the Settings tab's gear and the updater's autoUpdate setting). google 'refused': not shown to work, unchanged (#53 finding 2); not retried.
